Conditions

  • Astral Gravity

    Immune to Falling damage and Jump distance is tripled.

Features

  • Advanced Unarmoured Movement

    Difficult Terrain doesn't slow you down and you can Jump an additional 6 m / 20 ft while you are not wearing armour or using a shield.

  • Deflect Missiles

    Use your reaction to reduce the damage from a ranged weapon attack by 1d10 + your Dexterity Modifier + your monk level.

  • Evasion

    Successful DEX saves nullify damage; failed DEX saves reduce it by half.

  • Extra Attack

    Can make an additional attack after an unarmed or weapon attack.

  • Ki-Empowered Strikes

    Your unarmed attacks count as magical for the purpose of overcoming enemies' Resistance and Immunity to non-magical damage.

  • Martial Arts: Bonus Unarmed Strike

    After making an attack with a melee Monk weapon or while unarmed, you can make another unarmed attack as a bonus action.

  • Martial Arts: Deft Strikes

    Attacks with Monk Weapons and unarmed attacks deal 1d4⁠⁠Bludgeoning damage, unless their normal damage is higher.

  • Martial Arts: Dextrous Attacks

    Attacks with Monk weapons and unarmed attacks scale with your Dexterity instead of your Strength if your Dexterity is higher.

  • Opportunity Attack

    Attack an enemy moving out of reach.

  • Psionic Empowerment

    Your attacks deal an extra 1d6⁠⁠Psychic damage - the scars of illithid enslavement run deep.

  • Slow Fall

    When you fall, you can use your reaction to gain Resistance to Falling damage.

  • Stillness of Mind

    If Charmed or Frightened, automatically cast Stillness of Mind to remove them.

  • Unarmoured Defence

    Your reflexes are as effective as any armour. While not wearing armour, you add your Wisdom Modifier to your  Armour Class.

  • Unarmoured Movement

    Your movement speed increases by 3 m (10 ft) while you are not wearing armour or using a shield.

  • Experienced And Deadly

    The wearer deals additional damage equal to their  Wisdom Modifier with unarmed strikes.

Prelate Lir'i'c is a githyanki character encountered on the Astral Prism at the start of Act Three.

Involvement

She is the leader of  Orpheus's honour guard. The honour guard clashes with the party when the former attempt to free Orpheus and escape the Astral Prism on the road to Baldur's Gate. Upon approaching, she has gained the upper hand against the  Emperor in the fight over Orpheus.

Lir'i'c is always hostile and she and the rest of the honor guard must be beaten in order to progress through the game.
